claim: All trails created using the CloudTrail console are multi-Region trails; you can create a single-Region trail only with the AWS CLI or the CreateTrail API operation.

qualifiers.condition: Console-created trails are always multi-Region; single-Region trails need the AWS CLI or the CreateTrail API.

evidence.quote: All trails created using the CloudTrail console are multi-Region trails. You can only create a single-Region trail using the AWS CLI or [`CreateTrail`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/APIReference/API_CreateTrail.html) API operation.
